                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/20275256" title="发布于 2026-06-02 22:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Azure App Service】应用服务(Web App)实战：用 .NET 代码把 Connection 耗尽与 SNAT 耗尽演练一次</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 id="%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E6%8F%8F%E8%BF%B0" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="15">问题描述：</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="17">在<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/20239022" target="_blank" data-href="https://blog.mylubu.com/Posts/Details/202605310602211730">上一篇</a>里，我解释过 App Service 中两个容易混淆的概念：</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="19">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="19"><strong>Outbound Connection</strong>：worker 实例上的 TCP 连接资源，耗尽时常见 <code>SocketException</code></li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20"><strong>SNAT Port</strong>：出站负载均衡器在公网侧分配的源端口。每个实例通常按 <strong>128 个</strong>(估算,实际值可能大于它~)，耗尽时常见连接超时。</li>
</ul>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="22">只看概念还是抽象，所以我做了一个 .NET Demo，把问题拆成四个小实验：</p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>实验 1：Connection 耗尽 — 每次 new HttpClient()</strong></span></li>
<li><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"><strong>实验 2： Connection 优化 — IHttpClientFactory 复用</strong></span></li>
<li><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>实验 3： SNAT 耗尽 — 关闭连接池 + Connection: close</strong></span></li>
<li><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"><strong>实验 4： SNAT 优化 — 单例 HttpClient + MaxConnectionsPerServer ≤ 128</strong></span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E8%A7%A3%E7%AD%94" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="29">问题解答：</h2>
<h3 id="2-%E5%AE%9E%E9%AA%8C-1%E8%AE%A9-app-service-instance-%E7%9A%84%E5%87%BA%E7%AB%99%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E8%80%97%E5%B0%BD" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="54"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">实验 1：让 App Service Instance 的出站连接快速耗尽</span></h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">反例很简单：每个请求都 <code>new HttpClient()</code>，而且不复用、不释放。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">这样每个请求都会带来新的 handler 和连接池，短时间内大量并发时，worker 上的 TCP 连接资源会迅速堆积。</p>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验1的代码片段：</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> BAD: new HttpClient 每次都创建，handler 与 socket 累积</span>
app.MapGet(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/demo/connection-bad</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? url) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Runner.RunAsync(count, concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> client = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HttpClient();              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每次新建</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resp = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.GetAsync(url);
        resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
    });
});</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">异常错误信息：<span style="font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1)"><br></span></h4>
<blockquote>HttpRequestException: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond. (blog.mylubu.com:443) --&gt; SocketException: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond.

</blockquote>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验结果截图：</h4>
<p><img alt="connects error" width="666" height="388" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202606/2127802-20260602214524513-1434326421.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="3-%E5%AE%9E%E9%AA%8C-2connection-%E4%BC%98%E5%8C%96%E7%94%A8%E5%8D%95%E4%BE%8B-httpclient--ihttpclientfactory-%E5%A4%8D%E7%94%A8" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="82"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">实验 2：Connection 优化：用单例 <code>HttpClient</code> / <code>IHttpClientFactory</code> 复用</span></h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="84">优化思路是：只保留少量长期存活的连接，让请求复用这些连接。</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="86">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="86">复用 <code>HttpClient</code> 或使用 <code>IHttpClientFactory</code>；</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="87">用 <code>PooledConnectionLifetime</code> 定期刷新连接，避免 DNS 漂移；</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="88">用 <code>MaxConnectionsPerServer</code> 控制到同一目标的物理连接数。</li>


</ul>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验2的代码片段：</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> GOOD: 在 DI 中注册一次</span>
builder.Services.AddHttpClient(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pooled</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, c =&gt; c.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SocketsHttpHandler
    {
        PooledConnectionLifetime </span>= TimeSpan.FromMinutes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>),   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解决 DNS 漂移</span>
        MaxConnectionsPerServer  = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>,                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 受限连接池</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    });

app.MapGet(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/demo/connection-good</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? url, IHttpClientFactory factory) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> client = factory.CreateClient(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pooled</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从工厂复用</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Runner.RunAsync(count, concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resp = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.GetAsync(url);
        resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
    });
});</span></pre>
</div>
<h4>&nbsp;关键优化（vs 实验 1）</h4>
<ul>
<li>不再 new HttpClient()：用 <code>IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient("pooled")</code> 拿到共享实例。</li>
<li>配置 PooledConnectionLifetime = 2min：定期回收连接，避免 DNS 漂移问题。</li>
<li>配置 MaxConnectionsPerServer = 20（可在上方参数区动态调节）：把单一目的端的并发物理连接控制在安全水位。</li>
<li>结果：N 个 HTTP 请求 ↔ 至多 20 条物理 TCP 流，socket 不再泄漏。</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验结果截图：</h4>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="491" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202606/2127802-20260602214150016-890159666.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="4-%E5%AE%9E%E9%AA%8C-3%E8%AE%A9-app-service-instance-%E7%9A%84-snat-port-%E8%80%97%E5%B0%BD" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="127"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">实验 3：让 App Service Instance 的 SNAT Port 耗尽</span></h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="129">Connection 优化解决的是 worker 本地资源，但 SNAT 是另一层限制。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="129">只要每个 HTTP 请求都是一条新的 TCP 流，出站负载均衡器仍然要不断分配新的 SNAT 端口。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="129">App Service 单实例通常按 <strong>128 个 SNAT 端口</strong> 估算，耗尽后新连接会卡住直到超时。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="131">这个反例通过禁用连接池 + <code>Connection: close</code>，强制每个请求都新建 TCP 连接。</p>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验3的代码片段：</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> BAD: 禁用连接池 + Connection: close =&gt; 每个请求都是一条全新 TCP 流</span>
app.MapGet(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/demo/snat-bad</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? url) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Runner.RunAsync(count, concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handler = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SocketsHttpHandler
        {
            PooledConnectionLifetime </span>= TimeSpan.Zero,    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">  禁用连接池</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> client = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpClient(handler);
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.ConnectionClose </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 强制断开</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resp = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.GetAsync(url);
        resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
    });
});</span></pre>
</div>
<h4><span style="font-size: 1em">异常错误信息：</span></h4>
<blockquote>
<p>HttpRequestException: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond. (blog.mylubu.com:443) <br> --&gt;  <br>SocketException: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond.</p>
</blockquote>
<h4><span style="font-size: 1em">实验结果截图：实验测试SNAT的端口占用数 &gt; 128 个&nbsp;</span></h4>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="418" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202606/2127802-20260602214920023-523738598.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="5-%E5%AE%9E%E9%AA%8C-4snat-%E4%BC%98%E5%8C%96keep-alive-%E5%A4%8D%E7%94%A8--maxconnectionsperserver-%E2%89%A4-128" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="170"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">实验 4：SNAT 优化：Keep-Alive 复用 + <code>MaxConnectionsPerServer ≤ 128</code></span></h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="172">优化方式也很直接：保留连接池，允许请求复用已有 TCP 连接。</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="174">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="174">去掉 <code>Connection: close</code>，保留 Keep-Alive；</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="175">启用连接池，不再把 <code>PooledConnectionLifetime</code> 设为 <code>Zero</code>；</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="176">控制 <code>MaxConnectionsPerServer</code>，让同一目标的物理连接数低于 SNAT 安全水位。</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验4的代码片段：</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> GOOD: 注册单例 HttpClient，所有请求共享一个连接池</span>
builder.Services.AddSingleton&lt;SharedHttpClient&gt;(_ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handler = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SocketsHttpHandler
    {
        PooledConnectionLifetime    </span>= TimeSpan.FromMinutes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>),   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">  启用连接池</span>
        PooledConnectionIdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>),  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">  空闲回收</span>
        MaxConnectionsPerServer     = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>,                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">  &lt;= 128</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    };
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SharedHttpClient(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpClient(handler));
});

app.MapGet(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/demo/snat-good</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? url, SharedHttpClient shared) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Runner.RunAsync(count, concurrency, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 不设置 ConnectionClose =&gt; keep-alive 复用</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resp = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> shared.Client.GetAsync(url);
        resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
    });
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4>关键优化（vs 实验 3）</h4>
<ul>
<li>移除 Connection: close：保留 keep-alive，让服务端不会立刻关闭连接。</li>
<li>启用连接池：<code>PooledConnectionLifetime = 2min</code>（而不是 <code>Zero</code>）。</li>
<li>添加 PooledConnectionIdleTimeout = 30s：空闲连接超时回收，但活跃连接长保留。</li>
<li>MaxConnectionsPerServer = 20（可在上方参数区动态调节）：硬上限，远低于 128 SNAT 安全估算，确保不会撞墙。</li>
<li>HttpClient 注册为 Singleton：整个进程共享一个，所有请求复用同一连接池。</li>
<li></li>
</ul>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">实验结果截图：</h4>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="491" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202606/2127802-20260602215303439-738948199.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>总结：</h3>
<p>在以上实验中，观察App Service的Connects指标变动，当服用链接后，肉眼可见connections指标的快速下降。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="805" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202606/2127802-20260602220002538-1612523038.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E5%B8%B8%E8%A7%81%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98faq" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="249">常见问题（FAQ）：</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="251"><strong>Q：为什么实验 1 和实验 3 都会失败，但根因不一样？</strong><br>A：实验 1 的核心问题是应用反复创建 <code>HttpClient</code> 且不释放，worker 本地 socket / 临时端口 / 句柄会快速堆积；实验 3 的核心问题是禁用连接池并强制 <code>Connection: close</code>，每个请求都变成一条新的 TCP 流，导致同一目标上的 SNAT 端口快速消耗。前者更偏 worker 本地资源泄漏，后者更偏出站负载均衡器的 SNAT 端口耗尽。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="254"><strong>Q：只用单例 <code>HttpClient</code> 就一定能解决 SNAT 吗？</strong><br>A：不一定。实验 3 的价值就在这里：即使你“复用了 <code>HttpClient</code>”，只要禁用了连接池或加了 <code>Connection: close</code>，底层仍然是每请求一条新 TCP 连接，SNAT 仍然会被打爆。真正关键的是 <strong>连接池 + Keep-Alive + 合理的 <code>MaxConnectionsPerServer</code></strong>。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="257"><strong>Q：<code>MaxConnectionsPerServer</code> 应该设置成多少？</strong><br>A：没有固定值，但我的经验是先按目标服务维度控制在安全水位内。如果是同一个公网 endpoint，建议从 20、50 这类保守值开始压测；不要直接设到几百。App Service 单实例 SNAT 端口通常按 128 估算，因此同一目标上的并发物理连接数要明显低于这个值。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="260"><strong>Q：什么时候需要 NAT Gateway 或 Private Endpoint？</strong><br>A：如果代码层已经复用连接，但业务确实需要大量并发公网出站，使用 VNet Integration + NAT Gateway 可以把出站流量切到独享端口池；如果访问的是 Azure SQL、Storage、Redis 等支持私网访问的服务，Private Endpoint 更彻底，因为它让流量走私网，不再消耗公网 SNAT。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="260">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="56">&nbsp;参考资料</h2>
